title: ROFFU Multi-Tool
description:
ROFFU Multi-Tool
The ROFFU Multi-Tool combines three seperate tools in one. On one end you have a very handy scoop that is perfect for filling your ROFFU extraction chamber. And on the other end you have a brush. The third tool is hidden away and can be accessed by pulling the brush end out to reveal a long thin brush.
While the ROFFU Multi-Tool was designed to be used with the XLUX ROFFU, it can also be used in most other vaporizers.
Included
1 x ROFFU Multi-Tool
